ownerStatement: I'll add the approval record for the waived benchmark and stress rows once the points below are in, since it pins the source hash. (https://github.com/repeat98/modwerk/pull/1383#issuecomment-6763276021)
reason: First release, USB only. No MIDI path, so no cfmeter benchmark or flood was run. Cycles were counted in the Octatrack emulator and labelled as such: worst event 677 of the module's instructions, about 1,687 of 9,577 cycles. The author's MKII ran this exact package (50f64eb6) on beta base 72defb09: try and Undo, Keep with a minute of play, power cycle, removal. Hardware timing is not claimed verified. Limits are in TESTING.md and compatibility.limitations.
